title: alstonia costata
intro: Alstonia costata, commonly known as "Coral Tree" or "White Coral Tree", is a tropical evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia, belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which aid in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Alstonia costata include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and exert antimalarial effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, particularly alstonine and 19-oxoalstonine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
